source.text: ውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ባረክዎ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ስብሐት፡ ንጉሥ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ አስተዳለወ፡ *ለሰብእ፡ ከመዝ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወከመዝ፡ ፈጠረ፡ ወይቤ፡ የሀብዎሙ።
source.note: Selected Charles 1906 critical-edition printed p64/PDF102; continuing OCR is stored in ch26.txt but numbered 25:7 ends before XXVI heading. Asterisk retained before ለሰብእ; raised apparatus references are not running text.

translation.text: Then I blessed the God of glory, the eternal King, because he had prepared such things for righteous people, had created them in this way, and said that he would give them to them.[a]

footnotes.text: The printed word order around people, such things, and righteous is unusual; this English construes righteous with people. Charles 1906 printed p64 note19 discusses that order. “Said that he would give” follows the explicit speech verb rather than introducing a separate promise formula.
